## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-council-brand`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-council-brand -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `metadata.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `metadata.jsonl`
- `coliseum_hero_arena.jpg`
- `verifiable_evidence_card.jpg`
- `The_CSOAI_Ecosystem_Lifecycle.png`
- `The_CSOAI_Coliseum_Governance_Game.png`
- `CSOAI_s_RAS_AI_Compliance_Framework.png`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/council-brand at revision `5181014d9362bcd2028ffd4efbb9cc5e7445ae44`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# Council of AI — brand assets

Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677).

Independent measurement body. We measure AI systems on published, frozen splits, sign the card, and re-attest. We do not certify, accredit, or act as a notified body.

Living board: **23 axes · 23 measured.** Jail is a measured floor (TIE), not a 16th pane.

Numbers come from GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc — 23 axes · 23 measured (23·23·0).

Hub cells: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/hub-cards` → **re-GET** `counts.*` (typed Hub triples SUPERSEDED) (third-party Hub — not the board). Verify free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify. Anyone can check a card for free.

Canonical banks: the `csoai/gspc-*` datasets listed on the live API and the collection “GSPC measurement banks (Council of AI)”. Older names are superseded.

Public names: Council of AI, Council City, Council Space, GSPC, RAS.

Website: https://councilof.ai

![RAS AI compliance framework](CSOAI_s_RAS_AI_Compliance_Framework.png)

Jail is a measured floor, not a 16th pane.
